entries.description: Read project-guidance, lessons-learned, authoring guide, ai-led workflow, spec, add-an-order package, handoff (skim), characterization test models
Authored ai-assignment.md in-conversation per human directive (no external routing this set except cross-provider verification)
Created BlazorAddAnOrder project at output-tests/blazor-add-an-order/ targeting net10.0; added MudBlazor 9.4.0 PackageReference; appsettings.json carries Services:BaseAddress.
Authored Program.cs wiring AddRazorComponents + AddInteractiveServerComponents, AddControllers, AddMudServices, named HttpClient "services" with BaseAddress from appsettings.
Authored three namespaces: Ui (App.razor + MainLayout.razor + Routes.razor + Pages/Home.razor + _Imports.razor), Services (HealthController.cs at GET /api/health), Contracts (HealthResponse.cs).

In-conversation review: Ui has no .Services using/reference; Services has no .Ui using/reference; both reference .Contracts only; Program.cs (composition root) references Ui types necessarily for MapRazorComponents<App>(). Per human directive (no external routing this set except cross-provider session-verification), this review was not routed; verifier at Step 6 covers cross-provider check.

dotnet build AccessHarvester.sln: 0 errors. dotnet test AccessHarvester.sln --no-build: 10 test assemblies passed; aggregate ~2300 tests pass, 2 SkippableFact integration tests skipped (no Access COM in this environment).
Manual smoke-check steps for the human authored inline in spec's session review.

Cross-provider session-verification routed to gemini-pro via query() (per human directive — overrides default session-verification override of gpt-5-4 for this set). Verdict: VERIFIED, no issues. Cost $0.0105.

Read planning docs (project-guidance, lessons-learned), spec end-to-end, ai-led-session-workflow, add-an-order workflow package, handoff Section 3.3, characterization test sources to confirm constraint shape.

Surfaced Stop Rule #1 to human at session start (binding constraint: workflow classes are private sealed inside test files; AddAnOrderWorkflowModels.cs only contains internal sealed data types). Presented options A/B/C/D. Human chose D: clarify pilot success criterion to invariant-correspondence (no shared workflow code, no test-file edits). Decision logged in ai-assignment.md.
Appended Stop Rule resolution + Option D clarification + Session 2 routing-decision table to ai-assignment.md in-conversation per human set-wide directive.

Authored BlazorAddAnOrder.Services.Domain namespace: OrderEnums.cs (OrderStatus, OrderDetailStatus), OrderDraft.cs (OrderDraft, OrderLineItemDraft, PendingOrderDetail), OrderCreationService.cs (with ISystemClock, ICustomerCatalog, OrderCreationOptions), OrderLineItemService.cs (with IProductCatalog), InventoryAllocationService.cs (with ReallocationResult). Implements package Section 3 rules and Section 4 invariants without sharing code with the test fixtures (Option D resolution).

Authored InMemoryCatalog (seeded with 3 customers + 4 products) implementing ICustomerCatalog and IProductCatalog and persisting orders. Authored CustomersController, ProductsController, OrdersController. OrdersController orchestrates BeginOrderEdit -> ApplyCustomerSelection -> CanSave -> per-line BeginLineItem/ApplyProductSelection/PrepareForSave/CanAddProductToOrder/CanSave -> persist.

Authored Ui/Pages/OrderEntryPage.razor (route /orders/new) using MudForm, MudSelect for customer + per-line product, MudTable for line items, MudNumericField for quantity, MudButton for save, MudSnackbar success feedback. Calls only the named HttpClient services for /api/customers, /api/products, /api/orders. Added a navigation button on Home.razor.

Wired DI in Program.cs: InMemoryCatalog as singleton (also serves ICustomerCatalog and IProductCatalog via factory), ISystemClock/SystemClock, OrderCreationOptions singleton, OrderCreationService and OrderLineItemService scoped, InventoryAllocationService singleton.

dotnet build AccessHarvester.sln: 0 errors, 286 pre-existing warnings (all CA1416 platform-suitability and xUnit2013/CS8602 unrelated to this session). dotnet test AccessHarvester.sln --no-build: 0 failed across all 14 test assemblies. AccessHarvester.CharacterizationTests: 111 passed (AddAnOrder/ + UpdateAnOrder/ + UpdateAProduct/ + UpdateAnEmployee/) unmodified. Aggregate ~1720 passed, 3 SkippableFact integration tests skipped (no Access COM in this environment).

Cross-provider session-verification routed via query("gemini-pro", task_type="session-verification") per the human set-wide directive (overrides default session-verification override of gpt-5-4 for this set). First call returned 503 Service Unavailable (transient outage); 90s wait then retry succeeded. Verdict: VERIFIED, no issues. Verifier explicitly endorsed Option D resolution and confirmed all 7 focus areas (layer separation, invariant correspondence, test integrity, HTTP boundary, MudBlazor UX, DI wiring, build/test).
